baselines.name: llm_only
baselines.what: A model shown two raw descriptions, no attributes or gates
baselines.note: 160 of 160 sampled pairs answered (0 failed), balanced between true pairs and hard negatives. On the sample itself precision was 0.9365; the figure shown is that sample's recall and hard-negative rate rescaled to the catalogue's real 3,246/10,551 split, which is the only form comparable to the other rows. It also needs one model call per pair judged, where ours reaches a model on 0.0% of pairs in this run — the deterministic tiers settled every one of them. Sampled on the run before the identity veto; that change altered no candidate pair, no label and no Meridian merge, only 44 abstentions, so the sample is unchanged.

notes: No baseline abstains: a similarity score cannot represent a fact being absent, so every pair is forced to a yes or a no. Ours declines 3010 pairs and routes them to a person.
